summary: Test-only R04 under focused local runtime approval. Fixed the existing mounted final-text test synchronization with a bounded condition-based waitFor instead of fixed zero-turn waits, retained final/trailing assertions and added an in-flight 'Refreshing results...' assertion. Added tests for coalescer onBusyChange A success/failure with latched B queued/running, final settlement, max one in-flight, rejection swallowing/no retry loop and cancel; added mounted tests for cached equal-revision pending, cached failure error+Retry precedence with cached cards retained, uncached initial failure+manual retry, and no full-report request for WS frames while editing (Dashboard loads one). Focused isolated executions: 10 pass (lifecycle/r10/r09), 19 pass (findings-client), 23 pass (builder/self-paced/builder-views), total 52 pass/0 fail/0 skip, plus typecheck exit 0 (compile only). No app/API/coalescer/migration/config changes. Whole suite/browser/HR-ended/room-switch/load/cloud NOT RUN; no speedup or whole-app PASS claim. QA observed RED before the synchronization fix; corrected tests GREEN.
